anchor_value: source schedule prints the same six par amounts (USD thousands)

findings.detail: X06 treats deeply impaired or low-value revolver positions as scale errors even when principal, cost, and fair value exactly match the source schedule.

rationale: Class 1 review of all six localized principal cells found exact agreement with the raw March 31, 2026 schedule. The filing itself reports the large par-to-fair-value gaps and also shows similarly depressed cost, including Chase 21,185 par versus 1,372 cost and 1,343 fair value; therefore the extracted values are correct and X06 is firing on genuine distressed/revolver economics rather than a data defect. No aggregate anchor is needed for this row-level check.
